name: petri-seedlings
title: Petri Seedlings
subtitle: Seedling counts and axis length on agar plates
description: Counts seedlings on a plate and measures the skeleton axis length and bounding-box height of each. One row per seedling.
method: Rolling-ball background subtraction (radius 100 px), Otsu threshold, despeckle, then a binary skeleton of the whole plate. Each connected skeleton is one seedling; axis length is derived from the skeleton's calibrated Area divided by pixel height, since a skeleton is one pixel wide.
dataType: seedlings on vertical agar plates, dark seedlings on pale medium

outputs.name: AxisLength
outputs.label: Seedling axis length
outputs.description: Skeleton length of the whole seedling axis

outputs.name: Area
outputs.label: Skeleton area
outputs.description: Calibrated area of the skeleton; axis length is derived from it

notes: This macro does NOT split hypocotyl (PO:0020100) from primary root (PO:0020127). That split needs the seed/collet position, which requires SmartRoot tracing; a fixed-fraction guess would be fabricated data.

commonColumns.Label: Source image title
commonColumns.Unit: Spatial unit of every length/area column
commonColumns.Calibrated: 1 if a scale was applied; 0 means all values are in pixels
